sourceOwnershipMask.method: Eight-connected whole-figure extraction; intact major bodies plus their original disconnected ink, no limb repositioning. Every nonzero-alpha source pixel is assigned once; alpha-zero RGB remains in the immutable native.

limits: Native/contact-sheet candidates only; final Phaser transitions, physical devices and human acceptance remain open.
A fixed upright calibration scale is shared across every frame of each strip; crouched/lying frames are never fitted individually.
Native alpha compositing, contact sheets and exact reconstruction remain separate from rendered engine acceptance.
